transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
I've been having pain in my left flank. It's been going on for the last four or five days, and I've also been feeling sick to my stomach.
When did you first notice it?
It started about four to five days ago. It's been there pretty much the whole time since.
Is there anything that makes it better or worse?
I haven't really noticed anything that makes it better or worse. It just seems to be there.
How would you describe the feeling in your own words?
It's a steady pain in my abdomen, and it goes across my back as well. It doesn't really come and go — it's just there.
Where exactly do you feel it, and does it spread anywhere?
It's in my left side, in the flank, and I feel it in my abdomen and across my back too. I haven't noticed it spreading anywhere else.
On a scale from 0 to 10, where 10 is the worst, how bad is it?
I'm not sure how to put a number on it, but it's bad enough to be bothering me and making me feel sick. I couldn't really give you a score.
Is it there all the time, or does it come and go?
It's there all the time, not coming and going.
Has anything else been bothering you along with this?
Yes, I've had nausea and vomiting with it. But I haven't had any blood in my urine, and no pain or burning when I pass urine. I haven't had any fevers either.
Do you see a doctor regularly for any health condition?
Another doctor told me I have a stone of about 1.3 cm in the left ureter, the tube from my kidney. That's what I'd like to get sorted out.
Which medicines do you take regularly, including any new ones?
I'm not taking any regular medicines that I know of. Nothing new either.
Are you allergic to any medicines?
No, I'm not aware of any allergies to medicines.
Has this changed what you can do around the house or outside?
I haven't really noticed it stopping me from doing things, but the pain and feeling sick have been a bother.
Is there anything about this that worries you?
I'd just like something done about the stone in my ureter. That's my main worry — that it needs to be taken care of.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
